responsibility: Provides miscellaneous tree SSA utility infrastructure shared across CFG and SSA transformations. It manages per-edge PHI redirection maps used when redirecting edges and flushing pending PHI arguments, offers helpers to replace SSA LHS definitions while preserving debug annotations, and contains utilities for updating address-taken/addressable objects and rewriting memory references back into SSA form, making it a common support file rather than a dedicated optimization pass implementation.
same_name_distinction: This source file supplies the generic Tree SSA utility implementations such as redirected-edge PHI mapping storage, edge redirection/flush behavior, SSA-LHS replacement, and address-taken rewriting support, including the addressables pass object. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa.h, it is the implementation side rather than the pass-facing declarations.
